title: Mixed rules is never offered and the header type resets the column
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, two ranges, Default 40% markup then 15% margin.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Open Default's header rule picker.
  5. Pick Markup %.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • Default's header picker shows Mixed rules.

Step 4:

  • The picker lists + $, Markup % and Margin %.
  • Mixed rules is not one of the choices.

Step 5:

  • Both of Default's ranges are now Markup %.
